rendered: The anode-free sodium full cell, with a presodiated pyrite cathode, reaches energy densities of ∼400 Wh/kg[1]. The paper gives the theoretical maximum for LIB technology as 387 Wh/kg for LiCoO2/graphite cells[2]. The anode-free cell therefore exceeds that LiCoO2/graphite limit by 13[3] Wh/kg, a difference that is approximate because the paper's figure is given with a tilde. For comparison, the paper says the recent state-of-the-art sodium-ion full cells it cites reach ∼200 Wh/kg[4] with respect to active mass.
